audit.title: Administrative audit trail
audit.description: Account lifecycle and administrative configuration changes. Newest first, 50 entries per page.
audit.error: Audit history is temporarily unavailable. Try again.

lifecycle.failed: The account could not be updated. Check its current status and your permissions, then try again.
lifecycle.disabledHelp: Disabled accounts cannot be edited here. Re-enable the account first.
lifecycle.disableHelp: Disables login and revokes all sessions. Role and approval history are retained.
lifecycle.reenableHelp: Restores approved access. The user must log in again; no session is created.
lifecycle.deleteWarning: Permanent deletion cannot be undone. Only pending accounts with no operational history can be deleted.
lifecycle.confirmation: Type DELETE USER exactly to confirm permanent deletion.

errors.ADMIN_ACCESS_REQUIRED: An approved Admin with a local login credential is required.
errors.SELF_DELETE_BLOCKED: You cannot delete your own account.
errors.SELF_DISABLE_BLOCKED: You cannot disable your own account.
errors.LAST_LOGIN_CAPABLE_ADMIN_BLOCKED: The last approved Admin capable of logging in must be retained.
errors.ACCOUNT_HAS_HISTORY: This account has operational history and cannot be permanently deleted.
errors.ACCOUNT_NOT_DISABLEABLE: Only approved accounts can be disabled.
errors.ACCOUNT_NOT_REENABLEABLE: Use Re-enable Account for a disabled account; other accounts cannot be re-enabled.
errors.ACCOUNT_NOT_DELETABLE: Only pending accounts can be permanently deleted.
errors.PROFILE_NOT_FOUND: The account no longer exists. Refresh the page.

page.title: User access
page.description: Manage roles and access status separately. Only Active accounts can use the permissions granted by their role.
page.saved: Role and access status changes were saved.
page.saveError: The status could not be updated. Try again or check the RLS policy.
page.empty: There are no user accounts yet.

access.currentAccount: The Admin account currently in use cannot lower its own access.
access.editDescription: Manage role and access status for {{email}}.

branding.title: Asset report identity
branding.description: Set the institution identity used by generated Excel reports. Files remain on the local NetOps host.
branding.error: Report branding could not be saved. Check the file and try again.

telemetry.title: SNMP read-only telemetry targets
telemetry.description: Bounded SYSTEM-MIB and IF-MIB data for known inventory. The browser stores only non-secret profile references.
telemetry.deleted: The Managed SNMP target was deleted; inventory and Health Watch remain.
telemetry.secretNotice: SNMP community strings and passwords remain only in local runner configuration; this page neither accepts nor displays them.
telemetry.addDescription: Select an inventory node. For a new IP, add the device first.
telemetry.requirements: At least one network node and one diagnostic runner are required.
telemetry.empty: No telemetry targets are configured yet.
telemetry.deleteConfirm: Delete Managed SNMP target {{target}}? The inventory device, Health Watch configuration, and unrelated history will remain.
telemetry.profileAvailableHelp: Profile is available on the selected runner.
telemetry.profileUnavailableHelp: Profile is unavailable on the selected runner.
telemetry.profileHelp: Select a runner and enter the profile name to check availability.

errors.profile: the credential profile is unavailable on the selected runner.
errors.unknown: the target was not found or confirmation did not match.
errors.delete: the target could not be deleted.
errors.invalid: the payload or form values are invalid.
errors.fallback: check the values and access policy.
